[[File:Dragon Ball Z Panini TCG logo.png|thumb|Original Dragon Ball Z TCG game logo.]]
The '''Dragon Ball Z Trading Card Game''' is a two-player game published by Panini America in 2014. The [[TCGMix]] playtest covers the 314-card Premiere Set and offers a bot opponent.<ref name="catalog" />

== History ==

Panini released the new edition on 17 October 2014. The first set included starter decks and booster packs.<ref name="dbzrelease" /><ref name="dbzannounce" /> The 2016 rulebook names Richie Williams as game design and development manager and credits Joey DiCarlo, Eric Kunkel and Sean Poestkoke for design, development and playtesting. It separately credits James M. Ward, David Eckhard and Israel Quiroz for the original game.<ref name="dbzrules" /> Panini announced the end of its edition on 6 January 2017.<ref name="dbzend" />

== Gameplay ==

Each player starts with a Main Personality and a Mastery. Victory can come from exhausting the opponent’s deck, collecting all seven Dragon Balls or reaching five Anger at the highest Main Personality level.<ref name="dbzrules" />

== Online play ==

Players can [https://tcgmix.com/dbztcg/ open the game on TCGMix].<ref name="tcgmix-play-dragon-ball-z-tcg">[https://tcgmix.com/dbztcg/ Play Dragon Ball Z TCG], TCGMix. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107194321/https://tcgmix.com/dbztcg/ Internet Archive].</ref>
